name: Zero Gravity
description: Gravity switches off in an old library: books, dust and the subject float up into the light.

wardrobe.man: a cream cable-knit sweater, dark green corduroy trousers and brown leather boots
wardrobe.woman: a cream cable-knit sweater, a long dark green skirt and brown leather boots
wardrobe.person: a cream cable-knit sweater, dark green trousers and brown leather boots

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. The {subject} from the reference images is the only person in it: keep {their} exact face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline and hairstyle, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. Take only the face and hair from the references; the clothing, background and lighting are all new. The {subject} stands in the center aisle of an old library, towering dark wooden bookshelves on both sides receding into the distance, wearing {wardrobe}, looking down at {their} open hands. Warm light from brass reading lamps and shafts of late daylight from a high window cut through floating dust. A wooden chair and a small stack of books stand on the floor nearby. Wide symmetrical shot at eye level down the aisle, the full body in the center filling about forty percent of the frame height. Cinematic photography, warm amber tones, volumetric light shafts. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, book spines plain and unlettered throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands in the aisle looking down at {their} open hands when gravity switches off: the loose papers lift first, then the books slide out of the shelves and drift upward, the wooden chair rises and slowly turns, dust motes swirl in the light shafts, and {their} hair floats up as if underwater. The feet leave the floor and the {subject} rises gently about a metre into the air, arms opening slightly for balance, eyes moving from the hands to the floating books with quiet wonder, one slow blink, lips parting. Everything drifts slowly and weightlessly, turning in the warm light. The camera holds a wide symmetrical shot down the aisle and cranes up slowly. Sound: a deep soft whoosh as gravity lets go, pages fluttering, wood creaking, a low airy hum. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, zero gravity, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. Gravity switches off around the {subject} in the frame: loose objects nearby lift and drift upward, dust swirls in the light, and {their} hair and clothes float as if underwater. The feet leave the ground and the {subject} rises gently about a metre into the air, arms opening slightly for balance, eyes moving across the floating objects with quiet wonder, one slow blink. Everything drifts slowly and weightlessly. The camera keeps the same framing and cranes up slowly. Sound: a deep soft whoosh as gravity lets go, objects creaking and tumbling softly, a low airy hum. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, zero gravity, sharp detail, stable picture.
